statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r R : ℝ),
  0 < r →
    r ≤ R → DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R \ ball c r) → ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z = ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z

universal.type: DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R \ ball c r)
universal.name: hf

hyps.text: DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R \ ball c r)
hyps.name: hf

goal.text: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z = ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z
goal.rhs: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z
goal.lhs: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z

atoms: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z
∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z
